mapper.select: SELECT SEC_ID AS secId, /**债券代码**/ VALUE_SOURCE AS valueSource, /**估值来源**/ VALUE_DATE AS valueDate, /**估值日**/ LAST_PERIOD AS lastPeriod, /**剩余期限**/ PRICE AS price, /**市价全价**/ NETPRICE AS netprice, /**市价净价**/ M_DURATION AS mDuration, /**市价久期**/ M_CONVEXITY AS mConvexity, /**市价凸性**/ BPVALUE AS bpvalue, /**基点价值**/ SDURATION AS sduration, /**利差久期**/ SCNVXTY AS scnvxty, /**利差凸性**/ INTEREST_DURATION AS interestDuration, /**利率久期**/ INTEREST_CNVXTY AS interestCnvxty, /**利率凸性**/ BPYIELD AS bpyield /**市价收益率**/ FROM mst_BOND_VALUATION_INFO WHERE SEC_ID = #{secId}
